R0113.title: Malicious Player Poaching
R0113.definition: Using in-game communication channels to lure players to other gaming platforms through various persuasive tactics.
R0113.description: The perpetrator first familiarizes themselves with the target game's mechanics and gameplay; after playing for a period to unlock guild creation features and build some in-game strength; they recruit target game players into the guild and use guild announcements to require members to add their WeChat, then pull them into a 'guild WeChat group'; in the WeChat group, they promote other games (typically strategy, fantasy, or legend-style games) and mobilize members to join new servers.
R0113.influence: Leads to player churn from the platform.

references.title: Black-Grey Market: Called 'Wild Paths' by Modern People, 'Side Hustles' by Older Generations

observables: Low-activity or new accounts create guilds then send external WeChat/QQ group recruitment messages to members at high frequency
In-game chat/mail contains competitor game names, server-switching pitches, and external contact information
The same batch of accounts bulk-recruit players at a fixed cadence after unlocking guild features, directing them to join external groups
